headline: Contested Fronts Register Fresh Base Changes
war_summary: The latest returns show the contested belt still in motion, with the sharpest change along Nevish Line, where 13 base events were recorded in two hours and 39 in the day; its ledger now stands evenly at four Warden and four Colonial bases. Callahan’s Passage also remains hot, with six fresh events and 29 across 24 hours, now showing eight Warden and two Colonial holdings. Palantine Berm has posted five events in two hours and 36 in the day, while its present count is seven Warden bases. Weathered Expanse records three recent events and 27 for the day, with eight Colonial and one Warden base. Stlican Shelf has one event in two hours and 22 in the day, divided seven Colonial to two Warden. Kuura Strand’s 14 daily events have gone quiet in the latest six hours, leaving all six bases Warden-held. Heavy fighting is also visible in Mooring County, Linn Mercy, and Stonecradle through casualty and enlistment figures, though their recent base ledgers are less active. No victor is recorded.
